responsibility: Defines the ISO Modula-2 process-concurrency API built on top of coroutines. It specifies opaque process identifiers, process creation/activation/suspension/switching/waiting primitives, event-source attachment and querying, accessors for the current process identity, parameters, and urgency, plus the process-specific exception query interface and an explicit rescheduling hook.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the standards-facing interface half of the Processes pair, specifying the opaque ProcessId type and process/event operations; the companion Processes.mod provides the actual scheduler, queues, coroutine transfers, idle process, and exception-source machinery that implement that API.
